scope: four agent-specific system-design category indexes only
cause: The canonical skill parser and selected-ID filter were not the cause: all 13 staged system-design SKILL.md files parse, and the independent review confirmed desiredSkillIds plus ownership contain all 13. The lifecycle cause is scripts/generate-indices.ts applying indices before beginInstall/writeSkills, while SyncService begins with PassthroughWriter and then switches to OwnershipWriter. A 9-row bootstrap index can therefore pre-exist the ownership session; completeInstall(refreshIndices:true) recomputes from the full inventory, but OwnershipWriter compares against the pre-run previous lock only (not its in-run next entries) and classifies a differing unowned bootstrap file as unknown. The exact initial filesystem inventory was not retained, so the reason the bootstrap saw nine rows is not claimed. Repair: preserve all package directories, delete only the four target indices in the disposable stage, run the existing generator, then hash-guard each copyback.
